items.title: 企業如何防止AI代理「做錯事」，專家建議四大治理方向
items.summary: 過去一年，「代理式AI」（Agentic AI）成了科技圈熱門關鍵字。從協助寫程式的自動化助手，到能自主處理郵件、管理檔案，甚至代為執行系統指令的智慧代理，這些工具正快速走進企業日常運作，成為員工桌面與伺服器環境中的新住戶。 當企業急著擁抱效率紅利，新的資安破口也隨之浮現。這些擁有自主行動能力的AI代理究竟握有多少權限？IT與資安部門是否知道員工的電腦裡裝了什麼？一旦AI代理判斷失準、代為執行了不該執行的動作，企業又該如何應對？

items.title: fix(apple): Shared OpenClawKit Periphery fails on every OpenClawKit P…
items.summary: fix(apple): Shared OpenClawKit Periphery fails on every OpenClawKit PR (#168171) The reconnect-backoff hooks added in #168024 lived in OpenClawKit Sources but were called only from OpenClawKitTests. The shared Periphery workflow scans the iOS and macOS consumer indexes, and neither builds OpenClawKitTests, so both reported _test_setReconnectBackoffMs(_:) and _test_reconnectBackoffMs() as unused and the intersection failed on every PR touching the kit. Move the setter into the test file's existing @testable fileprivate GatewayChannelActor extension, beside seedPathRecoveryConnectBackoff, and read the internal backoffMs directly. The remaining _test_ hooks stay because the macOS OpenClawIPCTests call them. Proof: swift test --filter GatewayNetworkPath (10 tests in 2 suites, including the reset-both-backoffs case) passes; SwiftFormat clean.

items.title: fix(release): settle generated npm locks at npm's reload fixpoint (#1…
items.summary: fix(release): settle generated npm locks at npm's reload fixpoint (#168191) npm --package-lock-only can assign nested override sets to a shared node differently on a fresh tree than when it reloads the written lock, so the package-local bundled dependency install (npm ci --install-strategy=shallow) rejected amazon-bedrock-mantle's lock with 'Missing: @smithy/types@4.19.0'. Rerun npm from the written lock until it is unchanged (bounded), folded into the existing shrinkwrap-override repair loop.
